name.en: A package you didn’t order, with a QR code to scan

how.en: You receive a package you didn’t order, often cheap items like baby wipes, toothpaste or seeds, sometimes appearing to come from Amazon. The seller uses the “delivery” to post fake reviews in your name. It can also mean someone has your personal information. Some packages include a note with a QR code to “see who sent it” or “start a return” that leads to a phishing site for card numbers or passwords.

text.en: A package you didn’t order arrives in your name.
A note invites you to scan a QR code to see the sender or return it.
The QR code opens a page asking for card details or passwords.
Fake reviews may be posted under your name.
Thank you for your order! Scan the code below to see who sent you this gift or to arrange a free return.
